variety_description: An early maturity, semi-dwarf, medium-slender grain variety grown extensively in east India. Developed by UBKV and released in 2008. Sturdy stem, good grain quality. Suitable for low and medium lands in the irrigated and rainfed ecosystems. Recommended for planting in both wet and dry seasons.  This is a preferred variety with successive vegetable crops. It has the good grain and cooking quality.
